thread:
sam_sales: FYI — major prospect (MedicaOne) sent a security questionnaire, asking for HIPAA+GDPR answers, tenant-level retention controls, and exportable audit logs. They want a firm timeline. Ticket: INC-2026-457

deepa_support: Got the Q attached. They're on a proof-of-concept now, likely to convert if we support exportable audit evidence + 1yr retention. Customer asks for CSV/JSON audit exports and an S3 push with proof-of-delivery :eyes:

ticket-bot: ticket created INC-2026-457 • https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/INC-2026-457

maria_pm: Can we scope this as a small initiative for the next sprint or is it a multi-sprint engineering work? Need launch criteria and acceptance tests from eng/security.

jon_eng: Quick clarifying Qs: do they need cross-region exports? Are they ok with a daily batched export or do they require near-real-time stream? Also is this for Hosted API only or Dedicated/Private too?

sam_sales: They said initial ask is Hosted API, but enterprise legal prefers Dedicated/Private as option. Prefer daily batched export to start. Cross-region optional but nice-to-have.

cj_security: From a controls perspective: must include user/action, timestamp (UTC), request id, model id, prompt hash (truncated), retention policy enforcement, and KMS-wrapped export. Also need signed attestations for PII deletion requests. Minimal checklist:
- SOC2: audit log retention + access controls
- HIPAA: enable auditability + encryption-in-flight & at-rest
- GDPR: data subject access & right-to-be-forgotten path

cj_security: Suggested acceptance criteria:
- Tenant-level retention config (configurable days)
- Export API that returns audit logs in zipped JSON/CSV and can push to customer S3 using customer-provided ARN
- Exports encrypted with customer KMS and audit record of export action
- E2E tests + runbook for manual export and deletion flows

jon_eng: Technical proposal (sketch):
```
RetentionConfig {
  tenant_id: string
  retention_days: integer // 0 = indefinite
  export_bucket: s3://bucket-name
  export_kms_key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-...:key/...
}
```
We'll implement a daily job that reads tenant KV and emits a signed manifest + gzipped JSON. Start with Hosted; extend to Dedicated via config flag.

maria_pm: OK. For prioritization — propose we scope an MVP for 2-week sprint: tenant retention config UI + retention enforcement + basic export endpoint (manual) + security review. Post-MVP: automated daily pushes and S3 integration.

deepa_support: Can we get a "what we will deliver" blurb for sales to share? One-liner + acceptance checklist.

maria_pm: I'll draft. One-liner: "Tenant-configurable audit retention and compliance export — manual export in Sprint 12, automated S3 export in follow-up." Acceptance checklist: 1) retention per tenant enforced, 2) manual export endpoint works and is encrypted, 3) security sign-off, 4) docs + runbook.

sam_sales: Perfect — they'll want estimates and SLA notes. Can eng give rough story points or timebox?

jon_eng: Rough estimate: MVP ~ 8-12 story points (UI + backend + security review). Automated exports + KMS integration another 8 points. Exacts after design spike (2d).

cj_security: I'll queue a compliance review. Also need to provide templated language for contract (export responsibilities, data deletion timeline).

maria_pm: Action items:
- jon_eng: 2d design spike + estimate
- cj_security: compliance checklist + contract language
- deepa_support: attach customer questionnaire and details to ticket
- sam_sales: confirm Hosted-only MVP ok with customer

sam_sales: Confirmed — they accept Hosted MVP and timeline if we ship manual export in ~3 weeks. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: Great. I'll put a triage card in the product board and mark as "customer-request" -> "high". Will update ticket with scope & acceptance criteria.

ticket-bot: ticket INC-2026-457 updated: priority=high, product-card=https://app.redwood.ai/boards/rd-123

maria_pm: Thanks everyone — we can revisit scope if legal pushes Dedicated deployment requirements.
